$comment: The scan failure + issue policy (issue #715, event scoping #738). `fail_on` is what a run fails on; `pr_fail_on` is the narrower set a report-only run would use (empty means REPORT-ONLY: findings are counted, printed, uploaded as SARIF and filed as issues); `enforce_events` names the ONLY events that may fail the run — the scan is its own daily pipeline and can never gate a push or a pull request (make check-security-scan refuses it); `issue_severities` is what `make security-issues` (#716) turns into a tagged issue. `require_fix` restricts all of them to findings the scanner says have a fixed version.
